vg1102a.title: SNK Neo Geo Pocket Color Crystal White Console Ohanabi Game Set Working
vg1102a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vg1102a.details: SNK Neo Geo Pocket Color handheld game console in a translucent crystal white body, sold with the game cartridge Pachislot Aruze Oukoku Pocket Ohanabi. Condition: pre-owned. Operation was checked with batteries: the power, the screen display and the buttons work, and the game starts and shows its slot screen (photos 3 and 4). The battery cover on the back is missing (photos 2 and 5), so the batteries are not held in place by a cover. The body has rubbing and dirt from age. Game guide stickers for Ohanabi are stuck on the front of the console and have been left on (photos 1, 3 and 4). Included, as shown in the photos: the console and the Ohanabi game cartridge. No batteries, battery cover, strap or box are included. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
vg1102a.why: A pre-owned SNK Neo Geo Pocket Color console in crystal white with the Pachislot Ohanabi game cartridge, checked and working, without the battery cover.
vg1102a.perfect: Retro handheld fans and Neo Geo collectors who want a working Japanese Neo Geo Pocket Color with a game.
vg1102a.exp: A pre-owned Neo Geo Pocket Color with the Ohanabi game cartridge in the condition described above. The battery cover is missing and guide stickers are stuck on the front.
vg1102a.cd: Pre-owned. Operation was checked: it powers on, shows the picture and the buttons work, and the included game starts. The battery cover is missing. There are signs of age and dirt on the body, and game guide stickers are stuck on the front. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
